snippet.title: The Escape to the Afterlife | Release Date Trailer | Launching June 18, 2026 on Steam
snippet.description:
The Escape to the Afterlife is a short Japanese horror game set in the afterlife of Showa-era Japan.

The protagonist has died.
What awaits her in the world beyond?

■ Release Date
June 18, 2026

■ Price
¥780 (regional pricing available)

■ Steam Store Page
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3569560/_/

■ Developer
Showa 3D

■ Official X
